run_get_digit360_devices: run get_digit360_devices to discover and list all connected DIGIT360 USB hub devices sorted by serial
run_get_digit360_by_serial: run get_digit360_by_serial to find a specific DIGIT360 device descriptor by its serial number
run_get_digit360_by_hand: run get_digit360_by_hand to map hand configuration entries to their corresponding DIGIT360 device descriptors
run_is_digit360_desc_valid: run is_digit360_desc_valid to check whether a Digit360Descriptor has all required fields populated
run_Digit360Descriptor: run Digit360Descriptor to create a dataclass holding serial, data port, audio, ICS, base version, and ICS version
